title: Document acceptance-submission authority settlement, the retryable refusal and its bound in the engram-host-adapter feature brief
outcome: The Invalidation section of docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md describes the following. An evaluator's first submission settles an unconfirmed naming authority over an unchanged naming before its root check. A still-unconfirmed authority gets a retryable 502 ("nothing was sent; submit the same verdicts again"), bounded at 3 unconfirmed submissions per attempt, with only the admitting check resetting the count. No authority owner or a stopped writer is refused as final at once. A real naming change is refused as final, as before.
acceptance: Document acceptance-submission authority settlement, the retryable refusal and its bound in the engram-host-adapter feature brief is done
